verdict: Quiet day with nothing that changes a production pipeline; most items fail the relevance bar outright.

stories.headline: MiniMax-H3 PTD LoRA pack published on Hugging Face
stories.body: A set of LoRAs for MiniMax-H3 image-to-video, built by Taobao's content-AI team, is up on Hugging Face with 4,236 downloads. Covers video and audio generation and distillation. Licence is listed as "other," meaning terms need checking before any client use. No ComfyUI node or workflow details given here, just the model weights.
stories.why: Worth a licence check if MiniMax-H3 video LoRAs are already in your ComfyUI pipeline.

stories.headline: Spy Agencies Had This Tech. Now You Can Build It.
stories.body: The 'God's Eye View' project demonstrates a successful fusion of real-time OSINT data (flight tracking, satellite imagery, maritime traffic) with photorealistic 3D environments, leveraging AI agents to automate the technical integration that previously required large engineering teams.
stories.why: The use of Cesium and 3D Tiles is directly relevant to Houdini users working with geospatial datasets. Gaussian Splat integration points to a growing trend of hybrid volumetric/mesh environments. The 'vibe-coding' approach with AI agents can be adapted to write custom HDA or Python scripts for data-driven environment automation.

stories.headline: The Best Open-Source AI for 3D & Blender Is Here - Kimi K3.1 Pro
stories.body: Moonshot AI has released Kimi K3.1 Pro, an open-weight model that benchmarks highly against Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra for coding and procedural 3D authoring tasks.
stories.why: This represents a move toward 'Agentic' content creation where a TD describes a tool (like a procedural transformer rig) and the AI authors the Python/Blender API code to execute it. This could integrate into Houdini via Python nodes or Maya via CMaya commands.
